sources.title: NYC LPC Stonewall Inn designation, 2015
sources.pages: PDF 3–4 description; PDF 20 facade photograph; PDF 26 landmark map
sources.inspection: Read building description and individually inspected facade photo and boundary map. Two-story 51–53 scope; three upper casements at 53, four at 51, basket holders, parapets, brick ground floor and stucco above. 51 rear wing is one story. Old salon/scaffolding excluded.

Individually inspected the current 650×489 storefront image in browser. 51 now has a dark visitor-center display window, light framed entrance under brick segmental arch and separate dark residential door; old salon awning removed. Page dates visitor-center opening to June 28, 2024.
sources.use: Geometry/color reference only; no image pixels or official marks embedded.
